svg.aria-label: On prem, the role decides what inside the places picked. Data plane: only the Data Plane Manager registers, manages and removes on prem data planes and views machines, metrics and non Kubernetes applications. Product entities in BW5, BW6 and EMS, that is domains, machines, agents and installations: Viewer views; Capability Manager and Data Plane Manager view and modify. Product Permissions only pick where: a product, an entity type or a single instance. Not a role, and no Read or Write of their own.

text.font-family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
